7 to 10.
3. Urgency Application (IA/12041/2025) 
is allowed.
4. An Amendment Application (IA/
12040/2024) has been moved by
petitioners. 
5. By means of the said amendment 
application, it is pleaded that during 
pendency of the present writ petition, 
respondent No.5 expired on 16.06.2020 
and since, the legal heirs of respondent 
No.5 are already party-respondent Nos.1 
to 4, therefore, there is no need to file 
substitution application and the petitioners 
want to write word “deceased” against the 
name and detail of respondent No.5 in the 
memo of parties.
6. Since the amendment sought by the 
petitioners is formal in nature, therefore, 
there is no serious objection from the side 
of respondents.
7. Accordingly, Amendment Application 
(IA/12040/2024) is allowed. 8. Let the necessary amendment be 
incorporated within a period of seven days 
from today by supplying the amended 
memo of parties.
9. Learned counsel for the respondents 
prays for and is granted two weeks’ time 
to file objections to the Delay Condonation 
Application (IA/12037/2024), Setting 
Aside Abatement Application (IA/12038/
2024) and Substitution Application 
(IA/12039/ 2024).
10. Put up on 23.09.2025 along with 
connected matter.
11. Interim order dated 10.08.2018 is 
extended till then.
 
 (Pankaj Purohit, J.)
